description: This file defines the PsrHttpFactoryHelper class that provides methods to convert between Symfony HTTP request/response objects and PSR-7 request/response objects using the PsrHttpFactory and HttpFoundationFactory classes. It serves as a utility helper within the OAuth service plugin for handling HTTP message conversions.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelper
classes.description: A utility class that facilitates conversion between Symfony HTTP requests/responses and PSR-7 requests/responses, using PSR HTTP message factories.

methods.name: getPsrHttpFactory
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of PsrHttpFactory, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getHttpFoundationFactory
methods.description: Returns an instance of HttpFoundationFactory, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: createPsr7Request
methods.description: Converts a Symfony Request object into a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface.

methods.name: createPsr7Response
methods.description: Converts a Symfony Response object into a PSR-7 ResponseInterface.

methods.name: createRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Request object from a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface.

methods.name: createResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Response object from a PSR-7 ResponseInterface.
